messages.content: Add OAuth2 login support for Google and GitHub to the Flask app
I'll add OAuth2 integration using Authlib. Creating implementation plan...
Plan rejected. Feedback: Please also add user profile linking - if a user signs in with Google after already having an account, link the accounts instead of creating a duplicate.

Good catch! I'll update the plan to include account linking logic. The system will:
1. Check if OAuth email matches existing user
2. If yes, link the OAuth provider to that account
3. If no, create new account with OAuth provider
4. Store OAuth tokens securely

thoughts.content: Need to integrate Authlib for OAuth2. Will create a new OAuthProvider model to store connection details.
Initial plan didn't account for account linking scenario. This is a critical UX issue that would frustrate users.
Updated approach: Add oauth_providers table with foreign key to users. Check email on OAuth callback before creating new user.
